newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's Inc raises payment on notes.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's Inc raises payment on notes.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said Tuesday it had increased the consent payment in amending 9-7/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 to $10 from $5 in cash for each $1,000 principal amount.
The company said it was seeking to change the terms of the subordinated notes of Parisian Inc, which is to merge with one of its subsidiaries.
In July, Proffitt's agreed to buy Parisian, a regional specialty department store company, for about $110 million in cash and about 2.9 million in common shares.
Under the agreement, Parisian is to merge with Casablanca Merger Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of Proffitt's.
After the merger, Parisian is to become a subsidiary of Proffitt's.
